title: Joined varsity swim squad
summary: Selected for the varsity squad; five sessions a week.
about: Made the varsity squad after a two-week trial. Training was 6:00–7:30 before school on weekdays, plus Saturday meets. Maya swam the individual medley and anchored the 4×50 relay.

title: Y10 Computing: intro to Python
summary: First programming unit: loops, lists and a text adventure.
about: The first programming unit in Year 10. Maya learned variables, loops and lists, then built a text adventure set in the school with six rooms and an inventory.

title: Joined Beach Guardians
summary: Student service club running monthly beach cleanups in Rayong.
about: Beach Guardians runs a cleanup on the first Saturday of every month at Mae Ramphueng beach in Rayong. Maya joined as a volunteer in Year 10 and became data lead a year later.

title: Cell biology lab report
summary: Microscopy of onion and cheek cells; scored 7/8 on criterion B.
about: First formal lab report in MYP Science. Maya prepared slides of onion epidermis and cheek cells, drew labelled diagrams at ×400 and compared plant and animal cell structures.

title: Campus composting audit
summary: Weighed canteen food waste for six weeks and proposed a compost bin.
about: Over six weeks Maya and two friends weighed canteen food waste every lunchtime. They found 38 kg a week and presented a proposal for a compost bin to the facilities manager, which was approved.

title: Regional champs: 200m IM, 4th
summary: Personal best of 2:31 at the regional age-group championships.
about: Regional age-group championships in Bangkok. Maya placed 4th in the 200m IM with a personal best of 2:31.4, taking four seconds off her previous time.

title: Recycling quiz web app
summary: First web app in HTML and JavaScript, used in a Y7 assembly.
about: A ten-question quiz about which bin each item goes in, built with HTML, CSS and JavaScript. It ran on the hall projector in a Year 7 assembly and 180 students answered on their phones.

title: Ecology field trip, Khao Yai
summary: Quadrat sampling and species counts in the national park.
about: Three-day Year 10 field trip to Khao Yai National Park. Students used quadrats to sample ground plants at three altitudes and compared species diversity.

title: Beach cleanup + litter survey
summary: Designed a tally sheet so 40 volunteers could log litter by type.
about: Maya noticed the club collected 30 bags of rubbish each month but nobody knew what was in them. She designed a tally sheet with 12 litter categories, trained 40 volunteers in ten minutes, and turned the results into a chart for the club newsletter.

title: Science fair: microplastics
summary: Filtered water from three canals and counted microplastic fibres.
about: For the Year 10 science fair Maya filtered water from three Bangkok canals, counted microplastic fibres under a microscope and compared the canals. The project won Silver.

title: Swim training camp, Hua Hin
summary: Week-long training camp; started to feel the time pressure.
about: A week-long camp in Hua Hin with two pool sessions a day and an open-water swim. It came during exam revision week, which is when Maya first felt the clash between swimming and school.

title: Reflection: why data keeps pulling me in
summary: End-of-year reflection on the science fair and the composting audit.
about: End-of-Year-10 reflection written for Maya's advisor. She looked back at three projects and noticed that each one turned on careful counting.

title: Cut to two sessions a week
summary: Dropped to two sessions to make room for coursework and code club.
about: After talking with her coach and parents, Maya dropped from five sessions a week to two, to make time for IB preparation and the new code club.

title: Arduino workshop
summary: Wired a temperature sensor and logged readings to a laptop.
about: A two-session maker club workshop. Maya wired a DHT22 temperature sensor to an Arduino Uno and logged a reading every ten seconds to a laptop over serial.

title: Tutoring Y8 science
summary: Weekly peer tutoring in the library for two terms.
about: Every Wednesday lunchtime for two terms, Maya tutored three Year 8 students in the library on science homework, mostly states of matter and forces.

title: Genetics unit test
summary: Year 11 genetics test.
about: Year 11 Biology test on Mendelian genetics, Punnett squares and pedigree analysis. Maya scored a 7, the top grade.

title: Eco-committee energy audit
summary: Read every classroom meter for a month; lights left on cost ฿18,000 a term.
about: With the eco-committee, Maya read every classroom electricity meter at 7:30 and 16:30 for a month. Lights and air-con left on after school were costing about ฿18,000 a term. Facilities installed timers in twelve rooms.

title: Last race: inter-school gala
summary: Swam the 200m IM one last time, then left the squad.
about: Maya's final race for the school: the 200m IM at the inter-school gala, in 2:33. After the meet she left the squad to focus on her projects and the IB.

title: Enzyme kinetics investigation
summary: Measured catalase activity across temperatures; first time graphing error bars.
about: An independent investigation into how temperature affects catalase activity in potato, measured by oxygen volume. Maya ran five repeats at each of six temperatures and plotted means with error bars.

title: Led the litter survey team
summary: Ran survey days for Beach Guardians and shared the results with the district office.
about: As survey lead, Maya ran three survey days, merged two years of tally data and wrote a two-page summary for the district environment office, which now asks the club for figures each term.

title: Data visualisation course
summary: Online course in pandas and matplotlib; 8 graded notebooks.
about: A self-paced online course in Python data analysis. Maya completed eight graded notebooks covering pandas, cleaning, grouping and matplotlib charts.

title: Mangrove planting trip
summary: Three days planting and tagging mangroves in Chanthaburi.
about: A CAS trip with 30 students to Chanthaburi. Over three days they planted 600 mangrove seedlings and tagged a sample of 50 so that survival could be checked six months later.

title: Started IB Biology HL
summary: Depot: IB Biology HL with Mr Okafor.
about: Maya began IB Biology at Higher Level with Mr Okafor, the start of her Diploma Programme science line.

title: Started IB Computer Science SL
summary: Depot: IB CS SL with Ms Nair.
about: Maya began IB Computer Science at Standard Level with Ms Nair, choosing it over a third science.

title: CAS: STEM club for Y7 girls
summary: Co-founded a Friday STEM club; 14 regular members.
about: Maya co-founded a Friday after-school STEM club for Year 7 girls with a friend. Over two terms, 14 regular members built light sensors, a micro:bit pet and a class weather station.

title: CO₂ sensor prototype
summary: One classroom sensor on a Raspberry Pi, logging every minute.

evidence.caption: Classroom CO₂ over a school day

about: A first prototype: a single CO₂ sensor on a Raspberry Pi in Maya's classroom, logging every minute. It showed CO₂ above 1,500 ppm by the end of double lessons.

title: Biology IA proposal
summary: Proposal: algae growth against water temperature.
about: Maya's proposal for her Biology internal assessment, on how water temperature affects the growth rate of Chlorella algae. It was approved with one change: add a light-intensity control.

title: Air-quality sensor network
summary: Built 6 Raspberry Pi sensors around campus and a live dashboard.
about: Maya built six sensor units from Raspberry Pis and PM2.5/CO₂ modules, 3D-printed weatherproof housings and mounted them around campus. She calibrated each unit against the school weather station and wrote a live web dashboard that facilities now checks daily.

title: Air-quality data report
summary: Cleaned 40,000 readings in Python and found the canteen PM2.5 spike at lunch.
about: Maya cleaned and analysed 40,000 readings from the sensor network in Python. Her report showed a PM2.5 spike in the canteen at lunchtime, caused by the grill extractor, and facilities moved the extractor vent.

title: Biology IA: modelling algae growth
summary: Fitted a regression model to 12 weeks of growth data.
about: For her Biology IA, Maya grew algae at five temperatures for twelve weeks, counted cells with a haemocytometer and fitted a logistic growth model in Python.

title: Data Science summer school
summary: Two-week online summer school; final project on bike-share demand.
about: A two-week online summer school run by a university data science department. Maya's team modelled bike-share demand against weather and presented to faculty.

title: Extended Essay: dengue and weather
summary: EE draft: can rainfall and temperature predict dengue cases in Bangkok?
about: Maya's Extended Essay asks whether rainfall and temperature can predict weekly dengue cases in Bangkok, using ten years of public health and weather data.

title: Youth hackathon: 2nd place
summary: Team of three built a flood-alert chatbot in 24 hours.
about: A 24-hour youth hackathon on climate resilience. Maya's team of three built a LINE chatbot that sends flood alerts by district, using live rainfall data. They placed 2nd of 22 teams.

title: Reflection: what service taught me
summary: CAS mid-point reflection.
about: A CAS mid-point reflection written for Maya's advisor and CAS coordinator, looking back at three years of service.

title: Extended Essay final submission
summary: Planned: submit the EE in January.
about: Planned: final Extended Essay submission in January, after a second draft and a viva with her supervisor.

title: Target: BSc Data Science
summary: Planned: start a Data Science degree.
about: Planned: a BSc in Data Science, ideally a course with environmental or public-health applications.

title: Design: product sketching
summary: MYP Design unit on orthographic and perspective sketching.
about: A Year 10 Design unit on orthographic projection, two-point perspective and quick ideation sketches for a desk organiser.

title: Piano Grade 5: Merit
summary: Graded piano exam.
about: An external graded piano exam with three pieces, scales, sight-reading and aural tests. Arun passed with Merit.

title: French: oral presentation
summary: Two-minute talk about my neighbourhood.
about: A two-minute oral in French describing Arun's neighbourhood in Bangkok, followed by questions from the teacher.

title: Y10 Computing: Python basics
summary: Moved from Scratch to Python.
about: Arun moved from Scratch to Python, rebuilding his old Scratch maze game as a text-based version to learn the syntax.

title: Joined jazz band on keys
summary: Rehearses Tuesdays; first time improvising.
about: Arun joined the school jazz band on keyboard. Weekly Tuesday rehearsals, and his first experience of improvising over chord changes.

title: Code club: first Pygame game
summary: A side-scroller with chiptune music I wrote myself.
about: In code club Arun built a Pygame side-scroller about a cat escaping a flooded soi. He composed an 8-bit soundtrack for it in a free tracker app.

title: 3D-printed phone stand
summary: Iterated four prototypes in Fusion.
about: A desk phone stand designed in Fusion 360 and 3D-printed in PLA. Arun printed four versions, changing the angle and adding a cable slot after testing with classmates.

title: Francophonie night performance
summary: Sang and played “La Vie en rose” at the Francophonie evening.
about: Arun sang and accompanied himself on piano for "La Vie en rose" at the Francophonie evening, in front of about 200 parents and students.

title: Spring concert solo
summary: Solo arrangement of a Thai folk song for piano.
about: Arun's own piano arrangement of the Thai folk song "Lao Duang Duean", performed as a solo at the spring concert.

title: DELF A2 passed
summary: External French exam.
about: Arun passed the external DELF A2 exam in listening, reading, writing and speaking, scoring 78/100.

title: DAW summer course
summary: Two-week course in a digital audio workstation.
about: A two-week summer course in a digital audio workstation: recording, MIDI, mixing, EQ and compression. Arun produced two finished tracks.

title: First EP, “Monsoon Loops”
summary: Four tracks produced at home, released on the school music page.
about: A four-track lo-fi EP recorded and produced at home, built from field recordings of Bangkok rain and street sounds. It was released on the school music page.

title: MYP Design: ergonomic controller
summary: Designed a one-handed game controller for a classmate with a wrist injury.
about: For a classmate with a wrist injury, Arun designed a one-handed game controller. He interviewed his client, built a cardboard mock-up, then 3D-printed and wired a working version.

title: French: written commentary
summary: Commentary on a short story.
about: A written commentary on a short story by Le Clézio, analysing the narrator's voice.

title: Piano Grade 6: Distinction
summary: Graded piano exam.
about: Arun passed Grade 6 piano with Distinction, scoring 132/150. His pieces included a Bach invention and a jazz standard.

title: Unity fundamentals course
summary: Online course; built a small 3D level.
about: A self-paced online Unity course. Arun built a small 3D level with physics, triggers and spatial audio.

title: Game-audio project: “Rainfall”
summary: An adaptive soundtrack that changes with the weather in a Unity game.
about: A Unity game in which a soundtrack adapts to the in-game weather. Arun designed the levels, wrote the C# audio engine and composed 14 stems that crossfade on the beat.

title: Jazz band: schools festival
summary: Band placed second at the Bangkok schools jazz festival.
about: The jazz band placed second of 11 school bands at the Bangkok schools jazz festival. Arun played keys and took a 16-bar solo in "Watermelon Man".

title: Arcade cabinet for open day
summary: Built a cabinet with a Raspberry Pi running student games.
about: For open day, Arun and two friends built a full-size arcade cabinet from MDF with a Raspberry Pi running six student-made games. Over 300 visitors played it.

title: Final French exam
summary: MYP eAssessment; then left French.
about: Arun's final MYP eAssessment in French. He then chose Spanish ab initio for the Diploma.

title: Sound design for the school play
summary: Designed and ran live sound for “The Tempest”.
about: Arun designed the sound cues for the school production of "The Tempest", from a storm opening to island ambience, and ran the sound desk for five performances.

title: Started IB Music HL
summary: Depot: IB Music HL.
about: Arun began IB Music at Higher Level, which includes composition, performance and a music technology coursework option.

title: Started IB Computer Science HL
summary: Depot: IB CS HL.
about: Arun began IB Computer Science at Higher Level with Ms Nair.

title: Started Spanish ab initio
summary: New language for the Diploma.
about: Arun started Spanish ab initio, a beginners' course for the Diploma.

title: MIDI controller PCB
summary: Designed my own 16-pad controller board.
about: Arun designed a 16-pad MIDI controller PCB in KiCad, with velocity-sensitive pads and a USB-C connection. The boards are being manufactured.

title: Music HL: composition draft
summary: First composition draft for Music HL.
about: Arun's first composition draft for IB Music HL: a three-minute piece for piano and electronics.

title: Spanish: first oral
summary: Introduced myself and my family.
about: Arun's first spoken assessment in Spanish: introducing himself and his family.

title: Piano Grade 8
summary: Planned: sit Grade 8 piano.
about: Planned: Grade 8 piano in June 2027, with a jazz piece as an own-choice item.

title: CS IA: procedural music engine
summary: Planned: IB CS internal assessment.
about: Planned: a CS internal assessment building a procedural music engine that generates game soundtracks from level data.

title: Target: BMus Music Technology
summary: Planned: study music technology.
about: Planned: a BMus in Music Technology, or a joint music and computer science course.

title: Joined ceramics club
summary: Thursday after-school club.
about: In her first month at the school, Lena joined the Thursday ceramics club, mostly to make friends.

title: Reflection: arriving in a new school
summary: First-term reflection.
about: A first-term reflection written for Lena's advisor, after moving from Munich to Bangkok in July.

title: Joined Language Buddies
summary: Peer support for new students who speak little English.
about: Language Buddies pairs new students who speak little English with a peer. Lena meets her buddies twice a week to help with classes and canteen orders.

title: 100 days of drawing
summary: One sketch a day for 100 days.
about: Lena drew one sketch every day for 100 days and posted them on the art department wall. She used pencil, then ink, then watercolour.

title: Welcome pack translation
summary: Translated the new-family welcome pack into German and simple English.
about: Lena translated the 24-page new-family welcome pack into German and simple English, and added a glossary of school words. Admissions now sends it to every German-speaking family.

title: First wheel-thrown bowl
summary: After six weeks of collapsed attempts.
about: After six weeks of collapsed attempts, Lena threw her first bowl on the wheel and glazed it in celadon.

title: Reflection: what 100 days taught me
summary: Reflection on the drawing challenge.
about: A reflection on the 100-day drawing challenge, written for the art department exhibition.

title: Ceramics showcase
summary: Showed three pieces, then left the club.
about: Lena showed three pieces in the end-of-year ceramics showcase, including her first bowl. Afterwards the club moved to Thursdays, which clashed with Language Buddies, so she left.

title: Started learning Japanese
summary: Self-study with an app and anime subtitles.
about: Lena began learning Japanese on her own with a phone app, kana flashcards and anime with Japanese subtitles.

title: Community centre mural
summary: Designed and led painting of a 6 m mural with 12 volunteers.
about: Lena designed a 6-metre mural for a community centre in Khlong Toei, gathered ideas from children at the centre, and led 12 volunteers over three weekends.

title: Japanese club: kana certificate
summary: Passed the club’s hiragana and katakana test.
about: Lena passed the Japanese club's hiragana and katakana test, reading and writing all 92 basic characters.

title: Started Japanese elective
summary: Depot: Y11 Japanese.
about: Lena joined the Year 11 Japanese elective, three lessons a week with a native-speaker teacher.

title: Reflection: why tutoring matters
summary: Term reflection.
about: A term reflection on two terms of Language Buddies, now with buddies from Korea and Brazil.

title: JLPT N5
summary: Planned: sit the JLPT N5 in December.
about: Planned: sit the JLPT N5 exam in December.

title: Personal Project: bilingual zine
summary: Planned: MYP Personal Project.
about: Planned: a bilingual German and Thai zine for new students, as Lena's MYP Personal Project.

title: Reading buddies with Year 4
summary: Read with two Year 4 boys every Thursday lunchtime for a term.

evidence.caption: Thursday lunchtime in the primary library

about: Kai read with two Year 4 boys in the primary library every Thursday lunchtime for a term. Neither liked reading, so he started with football magazines and comics, and by the end both had finished a chapter book.

title: Reflection: am I a science person?
summary: End-of-term reflection on choosing between the sciences.
about: A reflection written for Kai’s advisor in Year 10, when he was deciding which sciences to keep for the Diploma.

title: Animal shelter weekends
summary: Walked and socialised dogs at a shelter in Bang Na on Saturday mornings.
about: Kai volunteered at a dog shelter in Bang Na on Saturday mornings for three months, walking and socialising dogs that were nervous of people so that they could be rehomed. Eleven of “his” dogs found homes.

title: Chemistry titration lab
summary: Acid–base titration practical; 6/8 on criterion B.
about: A Year 11 Chemistry practical: finding the concentration of an unknown sodium hydroxide solution by titration with hydrochloric acid. Kai planned the method himself and repeated until three titres agreed within 0.10 cm³.

title: Biology field study: Bang Krachao
summary: Kick-sampled stream invertebrates to compare water quality at three sites.
about: A Year 11 Biology field day in Bang Krachao, the green “lung” across the river. Kai’s group kick-sampled freshwater invertebrates at three sites and used a biotic index to compare water quality upstream and downstream of a market.

title: Physics pendulum investigation
summary: Tested how length affects period; 7/8 on criterion C.
about: An independent Physics investigation into how the length of a pendulum affects its period. Kai measured 10 lengths with five repeats each, plotted T² against L and used the gradient to estimate g as 9.78 m s⁻².

title: Light-gate timer for the physics lab
summary: Built an Arduino light gate so pendulum timings no longer depend on a stopwatch.

evidence.caption: Light gate on the pendulum stand

about: After the pendulum investigation Kai built a light gate from an infrared LED, a phototransistor and an Arduino, so the physics department could time swings to the millisecond. The department now uses two of them in Year 10 practicals.

title: Climbing club
summary: Joined the bouldering club; climbing V4 by the end of term.

evidence.caption: Working a V4 on the school wall

about: Kai joined the senior climbing club, which trains twice a week on the school wall and once a month at a bouldering gym in Ekkamai. He started at V1 and was climbing V4 problems by the end of the term.

title: Started IB Physics HL
summary: Depot: IB Physics HL.
about: Kai began IB Physics at Higher Level, alongside Chemistry SL and Computer Science HL, after the pendulum investigation convinced him to keep it.

title: Thai poetry recital
summary: Recited an extract from Sunthorn Phu at Thai Language Day.
about: At Thai Language Day in Year 10, Noor recited an extract from Sunthorn Phu’s Phra Aphai Mani in the traditional chanted style, after six weeks of coaching from Kru Napat. She was the only non-native speaker to reach the final.

title: Reflection: three languages, one sketchbook
summary: Term reflection on drawing in Arabic, Thai and English.
about: A Year 10 term reflection for Noor’s advisor about the sketchbook she keeps in three scripts.

title: Portrait series: Faces of Soi 31
summary: Six charcoal portraits of older neighbours, each with their own words.
about: For a Year 11 Visual Arts unit Noor drew six charcoal portraits of older people on her soi: a noodle seller, a motorbike-taxi driver, the man who fixes umbrellas. She recorded a sentence from each in their own language and lettered it under the portrait.

title: Reflection: what the canal looks like up close
summary: Reflection after sketching Khlong Saen Saep for the printmaking unit.
about: A Year 11 reflection written after a sketching trip to Khlong Saen Saep.

title: Printmaking workshop
summary: Three-day linocut workshop at a print studio in Charoen Krung.
about: A three-day linocut workshop at a print studio in Charoen Krung during the December break. Noor carved a three-colour reduction print of a canal boat from her sketches and printed an edition of twelve.

title: Reflection: listening before helping
summary: Reflection on the first term at the homework club.
about: A Year 11 reflection for Noor’s CAS adviser after her first weeks at a community homework club.

title: Homework club at a community learning centre
summary: Helped Arabic-speaking children with homework every Saturday for two terms.
about: Every Saturday for two terms Noor volunteered at a community learning centre in Bangkok, helping Arabic-speaking children aged 8–12 with English and maths homework. She made a trilingual word list that the centre now gives every new volunteer.

title: Reflection: end of Year 11
summary: End-of-year reflection before starting the Diploma.
about: A reflection written at the end of Year 11 for Noor’s advisor, Mr Whitfield.

title: Exhibition piece: “Letters Home”
summary: Mixed-media piece of layered Arabic and Thai script, shown in the Year 12 exhibition.
about: For the Year 12 group exhibition Noor made “Letters Home”, a 1.2 m mixed-media piece of layered tracing paper. Her grandmother’s letters in Arabic sit under Noor’s replies in Thai, so neither can be read on its own.

title: Reflection: making art about exile
summary: Summer reflection linking her art to the Extended Essay.
about: A reflection written over the summer before Year 13, connecting Noor’s art to her Extended Essay on exile poetry.

title: CAS: community art workshop series
summary: Ran six printmaking workshops for families using recycled materials.
about: Noor’s CAS project: six Saturday workshops at the community learning centre where families made prints from recycled packaging, polystyrene trays and bottle caps. 46 children and parents took part, and the prints were shown at the centre’s open day.

title: Songwriting project: “Ferry at Six”
summary: First song for MYP Music, about the evening ferry; 7/8 on criterion C.
about: For a Year 10 Music unit Ploy wrote and recorded “Ferry at Six”, a verse–chorus song about taking the Chao Phraya ferry home with her grandmother. She sang, played guitar and layered a second vocal harmony.

title: Reflection: the youngest on the team
summary: First-term reflection on joining the U16 girls’ football team.
about: A reflection written for Ploy’s advisor after her first half-term on the U16 girls’ team.

title: Football: U16 girls’ season
summary: Started as a substitute and finished the season at left back.
about: Ploy joined the U16 girls’ football team in Year 10. She started the season as a substitute and played every minute of the last six league matches at left back. The team finished third in the Bangkok schools league.

title: Reflection: writing songs in Thai or English?
summary: Reflection on which language her songs come out in.
about: A Year 10 reflection on songwriting, written for Ploy’s Music teacher and advisor.

title: Choir concert and poster
summary: Sang alto in the February concert and designed its poster.
about: Ploy sang alto in the senior choir’s February concert and designed the concert poster, which was printed for the whole school and used on the school’s social media.

title: Reflection: the match I didn’t play
summary: Reflection on being dropped for the cup quarter-final.
about: A reflection Ploy wrote after she was left out of the cup quarter-final.

title: App mock-up for a client
summary: Designed a practice-room booking app for the music department.
about: For a Year 10 Design unit Ploy interviewed Ms Marín about how students book practice rooms (a paper sheet on the door) and designed a mobile booking app prototype in Figma. She tested it with eight students and redesigned the calendar view twice.

title: Reflection: end of Year 10
summary: End-of-year reflection across music, design and football.
about: An end-of-Year-10 reflection for Ploy’s advisor.

title: Lamp design project
summary: Year 11 Design: a bamboo pendant lamp, now in prototyping.
about: Ploy’s Year 11 Design project is a pendant lamp made from bamboo strips, inspired by fish traps from her grandfather’s village in Ayutthaya. She has tested three weaves for light pattern and strength and is building a full-size prototype.

title: Year 10 CS: algorithms unit
summary: Built a sorting visualiser in Python; 7/8 on criterion B.
about: In the Year 10 algorithms unit Mateo implemented bubble, insertion and merge sort in Python and built a turtle-graphics visualiser that animates each one, then timed them on lists of up to 10,000 items.

title: Reflection: why I like making things faster
summary: Year 10 reflection on what draws him to algorithms.
about: A Year 10 reflection for Mateo’s advisor about the algorithms unit.

title: Science fair: does music tempo change running pace?
summary: Tested 12 teammates running to music at three tempos; Bronze.
about: For the Year 11 science fair Mateo had 12 teammates run 800 m three times, listening to music at 120, 150 and 180 beats per minute, with a GPS watch recording pace and cadence. Cadence followed tempo closely; pace barely changed. The project won Bronze.

title: Football passing networks in Python
summary: Logged every pass in five of his team’s matches and drew the network.
about: Mateo logged every pass in five of the U18 boys’ matches from video, then used Python and networkx to draw passing networks. They showed the team relied on one central midfielder, and the coach changed the formation for the next match.

title: IB Biology SL: osmosis lab
summary: Potato cylinders in sucrose solutions; first Diploma lab report.
about: Mateo’s first IB Biology lab report: he measured the mass change of potato cylinders in six sucrose concentrations to estimate the water potential of potato tissue.

title: Reflection: end of Year 12
summary: Year 12 reflection, and admitting CAS has stalled.
about: An end-of-Year-12 reflection for Mateo’s advisor.

title: Summer research placement: GPU lab
summary: Two weeks in a university parallel-computing lab, benchmarking sorts on a GPU.
about: A two-week summer placement in a university parallel-computing lab in Bangkok. Mateo benchmarked radix sort and bitonic sort on a GPU against a CPU baseline, the data that became the starting point for his Extended Essay.

title: Library reservation web app
summary: A web app the library now uses to reserve and renew books.
about: For his IB Computer Science internal assessment Mateo built a web app for the school library: students reserve books, get a LINE message when they are ready and renew from their phones. The library has used it since August, with 640 reservations so far.

title: IB CS: algorithms problem sets
summary: Year 13 algorithms unit: graph search and dynamic programming.
about: Year 13 Computer Science HL unit on graph algorithms and dynamic programming. Mateo scored full marks on the timed implementation task and helped run the revision session for the SL class.

title: Underwater sketchbook
summary: Ink drawings of reef fish from aquarium visits and snorkelling trips.
about: Over Year 10 Sienna filled a sketchbook with ink-and-wash drawings of reef fish, sketched at the aquarium and from memory after snorkelling. Each page has the species’ common, Thai and Latin names.

title: Reflection: the bleached reef
summary: Reflection after seeing coral bleaching on a family trip.
about: A reflection Sienna wrote for her advisor after a family snorkelling trip in Year 10.

title: Charity run organiser
summary: Organised a 5 km fun run that raised ฿86,400 for a marine rescue centre.
about: Sienna organised a 5 km fun run around the school field and the neighbouring park. 212 runners took part and the event raised ฿86,400 for a marine animal rescue centre. She wrote the risk assessment, recruited 18 marshals and ran registration.

title: Reflection: why marine biology
summary: Summer reflection on choosing a direction.
about: A reflection written over the summer before Year 11.

title: Plastic-free week campaign

about: With the eco-committee Sienna ran a plastic-free week in the canteen: reusable cups, a container deposit scheme and a waste audit before and after. Single-use plastic collected from the canteen fell from 38 kg to 11 kg, and the canteen kept the cup scheme.

title: Reflection: what the campaign changed
summary: Reflection on what lasted after plastic-free week.
about: A reflection written for Sienna’s CAS adviser in January of Year 11.

title: Koh Tao clean-up dives
summary: Four clean-up dives on the school reef trip, logging every item.
about: On the Year 11 reef trip to Koh Tao, Sienna joined four clean-up dives with a local dive school, removing 64 kg of debris, mostly fishing line, and logging every item for an ocean-debris database.

title: Reflection: first data of my own
summary: Reflection after the reef logger’s first download.
about: A reflection written after Sienna downloaded the first month of data from her reef temperature logger.

title: Campus garden: first planting
summary: Started a CAS garden behind the science block; 14 raised beds.
about: Sienna’s CAS project: turning an unused strip behind the science block into a garden. During summer school she and nine volunteers built 14 raised beds from old pallets and planted herbs, lemongrass and morning glory for the canteen.

title: Reflection: choosing my EE topic
